otf.status: Best direct technical route, subject to live program and eligibility
otf.targeted_edits: Lead with a specific surveillance/censorship threat to civil-society users. Explain local handling, restoration-key risk, optional cloud QA and a usable deployment. Add partner demand, an independent security evaluation, language-specific tests and a maintenance budget.

hrf-bdf.targeted_edits: State the actual Bitcoin/Nostr/ecash or financial-freedom workflow served. Define a verifiable integration, maintainers and open artifacts. Do not insert a token Bitcoin reference into an unrelated general-purpose tool.

opensats.status: Conditional: direct ecosystem contribution and open licensing
opensats.targeted_edits: Provide a concise one-page case, inspectable repository/license, direct Bitcoin/Nostr utility and public education materials. A general privacy product without ecosystem benefit remains a weak route.

mozilla-mtf.status: Conditional: match the actual current theme/program
mozilla-mtf.targeted_edits: Name the exact open call and public-interest community. Show a reusable open artifact, transparent evaluation and community stewardship. Historical AI/environmental awards do not prove a generic privacy fellowship is available.

fij.status: Standalone software route weak; needs a qualifying investigation
fij.targeted_edits: Identify the new wrongdoing question, preliminary findings, sources, reporting roadmap and US English-language publication commitment. Budget the tool only where it enables eligible reporting costs; do not omit the investigation.

jfe.status: Program-dependent: newsroom innovation or qualifying cross-border team
jfe.targeted_edits: Select the actual microgrant versus cross-border program first. For cross-border reporting, specify journalists/countries, European public relevance, story plan and editorial outlets. For newsroom innovation, define a bounded prototype and audience benefit.

ij4eu.status: Reporting-led route; eligible multinational investigation required
ij4eu.targeted_edits: Open with the cross-border investigation and publication partners. Connect pseudonymization to a documented collaboration/source-protection bottleneck, risk assessment, hard costs and independent editorial judgment.

pulitzer-center.status: Reporting-led route with concrete data method
pulitzer-center.targeted_edits: Specify the underreported public-interest question, outlet commitment, data access and verified methodology. Separate privacy of source material from safely shareable code/methods. AI-accountability topic similarity alone is not product-grant eligibility.

civil-rights-defenders.status: Emergency/partnership route, not established open product R&D
civil-rights-defenders.targeted_edits: Connect a documented defender threat to a practical deployment/training intervention and safety outcome; consider a separate long-term implementation partnership. Do not present general software research as acute emergency relief.

freedom-house.status: Emergency/resilience support only where actual need qualifies
freedom-house.targeted_edits: Describe the verified threat, urgency, eligible short-term cost and how the intervention lets a defender/organization continue its work. Protect identities; a long software roadmap does not establish emergency eligibility.

european-endowment-for-democracy.status: Conditional: eligible geography and locally rooted democracy actors
european-endowment-for-democracy.targeted_edits: Lead with a named or safely pseudonymized local partner's democratic work, why ordinary support is unavailable and how the tool enables continuity/accountability. Provide references and a proportionate operational budget.

national-endowment-for-democracy.status: Plausible civic deployment route; organizational eligibility unknown
national-endowment-for-democracy.targeted_edits: Center a country/region and local accountability users. Link the tool to secure documentation/reporting, deliver training and maintenance, and connect activity costs to observable civic outcomes.

creative-europe.status: Consortium workstream; program/call conditions must be checked
creative-europe.targeted_edits: Develop a real transnational newsroom partnership with languages, work packages, distribution, editorial independence and shared evaluation. Check topic-specific co-financing; avoid confusing an intermediary grant with software funding.

open-society.status: Program/relationship access unknown; history spans distinct strategies
open-society.targeted_edits: Start with civic actors' ability to act safely and the implementing organization's capacity. Identify the relevant program and approach route before writing. Historical regional/Justice grants do not prove current eligibility.

ecpmf-mfrr.status: JiR residency is a different instrument from software development
ecpmf-mfrr.targeted_edits: For a real relocation request, document journalism and verified threat. For the tool, seek a separate eligible partnership/training or capacity-support route; residency precedents do not support a product-development ask.
